note: MDC area north of Williamsburg, managed for quail and field trials. Camping is on two gravel lots at the north end of the area's main gravel road, just north of Big Lake: a larger lot at the end of a 100 m spur and a small one at the road bend, with a privy nearby; no pads, tables or water. Big Lake is about 130 m off through timber and not in view, and is under renovation (closed to boats in 2026). A second designated spot, 4 km east, is the parking lot of the rifle and pistol range. The whole area closes to all public use during managed firearms deer hunts (in 2026: October 16-18, November 19-23, December 4-6). --Claude
summary: Confirmed: two MDC-designated camping areas (map symbols + GIS points), both gravel lots; the pinned north-west one by Big Lake is the main one, the other is the shooting-range lot. No horse or dog-trial camp shared. Free/FCFS/14 nights/no hookups confirmed. Not waterfront stands (no upgrade lead). Small pin move onto the lot. Phone lead 573-815-7900.
flags: HOW MANY CAMPING AREAS: two. The page says 'Camping is allowed in designated locations. Refer to the area map.' and lists 'Designated Camping Sites'; the brochure: 'Camping is allowed anytime in designated camping areas shown on map. These may or may not have defined campsites. No amenities are provided. Seasonal closures and restrictions may apply.' The 3/3/2026 map legend has 'Camping Area' and draws it twice: (1) at the north end of the improved road beside two Parking symbols and a Privy, just north of Big Lake - GIS 'Primitive Camping Area' 38.96699,-91.73168; (2) on the east boundary beside the Rifle & Pistol Range and Shotgun Range symbols - GIS 38.95031,-91.69017, 3.9 km east-south-east.

WHAT IS ON THE GROUND (lot rule - both STAY as designated points at lots): (1) north-west: a gravel lot about 25 x 45 m at the end of a 100 m gravel spur, the GIS camping point on its west edge, plus a small gravel pull-off lot 110 m east at the road bend; grassland and food plots around, woods to the west. 'Level gravel lots' in the stored note is right. (2) east: the camping point falls ON the shooting range's gravel parking lot (about 35 x 40 m), 30 m from the range's firing line. Neither is a built camp. MAIN ONE: the north-west lots (two lots, privy, by the lakes); the range lot is a poor second.

SPLIT: none proposed. The east spot is 3.9 km away on its own entrance from the county road on the east side, but it is a single lot that is the range's own parking - under the split rule (more than a single small lot) it does not qualify. Nothing else in the database within 2.5 km of either point.

HORSE / DOG-TRIAL CAMP: none shared. The page lists Dog Training and Field Trials ('Field trials permitted by special use permit only'); the brochure requires a special use permit to ride horses on service roads. No horse camp or trial grounds camp is marked on the map.

WATERFRONT - NOT WATERFRONT STANDS, NO UPGRADE LEAD: from the larger lot the nearest arm of Big Lake is about 130 m south-west through closed timber, across the area road; a small diked pond (under an acre) is about 85 m south across the road. Nothing is seen from the lots. Big Lake itself is under renovation: page notices 'Big Lake is closed to boats due to on-going renovations.' and 'Due to ongoing construction in/around Big Lake, the surrounding area is closed to ALL HUNTING.' The stored note's 'beside Big Lake' overstated it; reworded.

CLOSURE DATES (in the note, dated): 'Whetstone Creek CA will be closed to all public uses during managed firearms deer hunts. Those 2026 dates will be: October 16-18; November 19-23; and December 4-6.' Not a status (the area is open otherwise).

PIN MOVE (minor, 115 m): stored 38.9665,-91.7302 is on the gravel road junction about 50 m south of the small pull-off lot. Proposed 38.96687,-91.73149, the centre of the larger gravel lot where the GIS camping point (38.96699,-91.73168, at the lot's west edge) is.
PHONE (lead, not written by apply): none stored. The page's 'For more information call' number is (573) 815-7900.
TOILETS: stored vault_toilets true is consistent with the map's Privy symbol beside the north-west parking symbols; the brochure's 'No amenities are provided' is about the campsites. Left as stored.
ACCESS: from the County Road 1003 entrance about 3 km of the area's improved gravel road north to the lots; no ford, no posted limit, no 4WD wording.
